# Controlled A103 v2 Homology registry

The four input files are exact retained outputs from `runs/root_a103_parent_private_behavior_02/checks/pytest/tmp/test_actual_parent_constructs_0`. The original own-A103 helper called real `HomologyJobs.create` and `order` for the first annotation/markerless/no-receipts direction case. `PROVENANCE.json` pins the original source epoch, helper, implementation and each retained byte sequence.

This is an engineering fixture, not historical scientific evidence. The executable identity is the original plain-text `unexecuted-program`; it was never executed. The original database contains one selected cpu=1 order, no submission or staged inputs, no handoffs, and no samples. The source run's incomplete/failing aggregate outcome is not claimed as validation of this fixture or of the current policy.

`configuration.json` retains its original v2 bytes, registry identity and absolute operand paths. The test copies only that file and `jobs.sqlite` into its temporary directory and exercises read/order/reopen operations there. It does not open the original absolute operand paths, configure a historical worker, submit work or manufacture a receipt. The two original operand files are retained here to authenticate their declared bytes independently of the old run directory.

The input files are immutable test assets. New selected counts are written only to the temporary copied registry. The required compatibility assertions are part of the existing selected-thread identity test, not a separate test cohort.
